Name: Summer Bird and Cicada Sounds (no flies sound)
Author: Chread
Description:
[color=#ffd966]No more Custom Music! This content pack[/color][color=#ffd966] only requires [/color][color=#ffd966][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and Stardew Valley 1.6 or higher﻿. For something similar for Custom Music check this out: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7652]Custom Summer Sounds[/url].
[/color]
Hello everyone!

This content pack removes the buzzing insects sound from the summer ambience. This sound can be pretty triggering and annoying. There are still birds and very subtle cicada sounds. Enjoy!

To see an example of what this content pack sounds like press the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20998?tab=videos]Videos[/url]" tab.


[b]Installation:[/b] Unzip the folder first, then you put the "[CP] Summer Bird and Cicada Sounds" folder in your Mods folder. This mod requires you to have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043?tab=files&BH=2]Custom Music[/url] is [u]not[/u] required.
[b]Incompatible:[/b]  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7652]Custom Summer Sounds[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20004]No flies in summer[/url].



[i]Future plans:[/i]  None.

If you have any suggestions let me know.

Check out my other content packs [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/chrisdegod/mods]here[/url].
